title: Mosadaqa Guidance
description: Understand the verification request, prepare questions for your university, and check the official platform instructions.
answer: Mosadaqa is an academic certificate verification platform. Our role is independent preparation guidance; the platform and relevant institutions control verification and decisions.

sections.title: Who this helps
sections.text: Graduates who have received a request for academic verification for use in Saudi Arabia. Start with the exact wording of the request, not an assumed sequence.

sections.title: What we can help you prepare
sections.text: A record of the qualification, awarding institution, study details and any difference between your academic and identity records. We can help organise questions to ask the university or official platform.

sections.title: What stays with you
sections.text: You retain control of your account, consent, credentials and payments. Follow the official platform’s rules for applications. Never share a password or one-time code with an intermediary.

sections.title: Before you begin
sections.text: Confirm the current official checklist and whether your qualification is within scope. Ask the recipient whether it wants verification, recognition or another form of evidence; these are different decisions.

steps: Compare the academic and identity records
